name: model-router
description: Routes each subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev. For each routed Agent call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider option allows, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description. The scope option picks the calls: core routes the four built-in agents, extended also routes user, project and plugin agents and sends their text. A config tool opens the plugin's own dialog to change both options. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Claude Code starts.

provider.description: Shows or changes whose model scores subagent calls: typesafe.
provider.content: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "provider" it asks the person whose model should score subagent calls and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its provider option in the plugin's settings.

gateway.description: Shows or changes how OpenRouter is used for the provider: direct, auto, openrouter-first, openrouter.
gateway.content: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "gateway" it asks the person how OpenRouter should be used for the provider and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its gateway option in the plugin's settings.

scope.description: Shows or changes which agent calls the router routes: core, extended.
scope.content: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "scope" it asks the person which agent calls the router should route and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its scope option in the plugin's settings.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider option allows TypeSafe. The README says where to get one.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Your OpenRouter API key. The plugin sends it to OpenRouter only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider option allows OpenRouter.

provider.title: Scoring provider
provider.description: Whose model scores a subagent call. typesafe: Jev from TypeSafe, the model the plugin's questions are fitted to.

gateway.title: OpenRouter gateway
gateway.description: How OpenRouter is used to reach the provider. direct: the provider's own API only. auto: the provider's own API, then OpenRouter if it fails. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then the provider's own API if it fails. openrouter: OpenRouter only. With auto or openrouter-first and both keys set, one call may reach both companies.

scope.title: Routing scope
scope.description: Which Agent calls the plugin routes. core: the built-in agents general-purpose, claude, Explore and Plan only. extended: also any Agent call that passes no model, including plugin and user agents, replacing the model and effort their definition sets. Forks and named calls stay unrouted.
